en: Monochrome religious postcard showing an artistic depiction of the Last Supper. Christ stands in the center with a radiant halo, holding the Eucharistic bread, surrounded by the twelve apostles seated and reclining around a semicircular table with a large menorah in front. Above them a larger, faint figure of Christ appears in blessing. The scene is framed by an arch, and behind/around the image there is dense printed text in a serif font.
